nodes.name: Gir Online Permit
nodes.description: This service allows online booking of permits for visiting Gir Jungle Safari, GIZ Devalia Safari, Ambardi Safari Park, and Girnar Nature Safari.

sources.evidence: The 'e-Permit' is for a visit to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' only.

Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.

For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date. It closes down two hours before the date.

eligibility: A person must have one year of experience under a certified electrician or engineer to appear in the wireman examination.
